# Error catalog

<!-- GENERATED FILE — do not edit by hand. Source: src/core/error-matrix.ts and
src/core/errors.ts; regenerate with `npm run metadata`. CI fails if it drifts. -->

What `facebook-mcp` reports when a Graph call fails, whether it retries, and
what to do about it. Every row below is rendered from the classifier the
server ships, so the text is exactly what a failing tool call returns.

## Reading a failed tool call

A tool call that fails on a Graph error returns an error result with these
fields:

| Field                       | Meaning                                                                                                                    |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `error`                     | The error message (redacted, prefixed with the HTTP status).                                                               |
| `code` / `subcode`          | Graph's error code and `error_subcode`.                                                                                    |
| `httpStatus`                | The HTTP status of the refusing response.                                                                                  |
| `fbtraceId`                 | Graph's trace id — what Meta support asks for.                                                                             |
| `userTitle` / `userMessage` | Meta's own human-readable reason, when it sent one. On a publishing or ads refusal this is often the only concrete reason. |
| `category`                  | The class of failure (the **Category** column below).                                                                      |
| `retryable`                 | Whether repeating the same call can succeed. `false` means it will fail identically until something changes.               |
| `nextTool`                  | The tool to run next to diagnose or verify, when one helps.                                                                |
| `retryAfterMs`              | A surfaced cool-down estimate. Never a promise: wait at least this long before repeating.                                  |
| `action`                    | The operator guidance (the **What to do** column below).                                                                   |

For an `auth` or `permission` failure, run the doctor (`<launch> doctor`)
first: it shows which token is live, its granted scopes and a per-package
usable / partial / blocked matrix. `<launch>` is the form you start the
server with — `npx -y @ivanbaev/facebook-mcp`, `facebook-mcp` after a global
install, or `node build/index.js` from a source checkout.

## Retries

- **Throttles** (the `rate_limit` codes marked _Retried in-process_, and a
  bare HTTP 429) are retried inside the server for reads and writes alike —
  the request was refused without being processed. Each wait is capped at
  60 s; a longer wait Graph names is not slept on but surfaced as
  `retryAfterMs`. Once the in-process retries are spent the throttle is
  returned with `retryable: false` and the wait Graph named, if any, as
  `retryAfterMs`.
- **HTTP 5xx and network faults** are retried inside the server on reads only.
  On a write the outcome is unknown — the change may have landed — so it is
  returned as `ambiguous` and never retried: verify, then decide.
- **Everything else** is returned on the first failure. `retryable` says
  whether the caller may repeat it.

## Classified ahead of the matrix

Two refusals arrive under codes the matrix already claims, but mean something
else; Graph names them only in its message, so the server checks for them
first.

| Situation                                                   |     Category     | Retryable | Next tool | What the server tells you                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ----------------------------------------------------------- | :--------------: | :-------: | :-------: | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Code `100` whose message names `appsecret_proof`            |      `auth`      |    no     |     —     | Graph rejected the appsecret_proof (code 100) — a server credential problem, not a tool-argument error, so changing the arguments or retrying will fail identically. The proof is derived from FB_APP_SECRET: check that FB_APP_SECRET is set and is the secret of the SAME Meta app that issued the access token (a token minted in another app, e.g. Graph API Explorer, or a rotated app secret both cause this), then restart and run `<launch> doctor`. |
| Code `1` or `100` whose message names the pagination cursor | `cursor_expired` |    no     |     —     | Pagination cursor expired — the saved cursor is no longer valid. Do not reuse it; restart the listing from the beginning.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

## Codes the matrix does not know

| Situation                                             |  Category   | Retryable | Next tool | What the server tells you                                                                                                                                |
| ----------------------------------------------------- | :---------: | :-------: | :-------: | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Any other code, flagged `is_transient: true` by Graph | `transient` |    yes    |     —     | Graph error (code `<n>`) is unclassified but flagged transient by Graph. Retry with backoff; for a write, verify whether it landed before repeating it.  |
| Any other code                                        |  `unknown`  |    no     |     —     | Unclassified Graph error (code `<n>`). Not retried automatically — inspect the message and fbtrace_id, then decide whether the action is safe to repeat. |

## Failures without a Graph error

A response with no Graph error envelope (an HTML page from an edge or a
proxy, an empty 5xx) or no response at all.

| Situation                                                                         |   Category   | Retryable |    Next tool     | What the server tells you                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :----------: | :-------: | :--------------: | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| HTTP 5xx, no Graph error envelope                                                 | `transient`  |    yes    |        —         | HTTP 5xx with no Graph error envelope (non-JSON body). Safe to retry idempotent reads after a short backoff; the api layer caps any internal wait at 60s and applies jitter. If you are behind a corporate proxy or TLS interception, check HTTPS_PROXY, HTTP_PROXY, ALL_PROXY and NO_PROXY (and their lowercase forms): facebook-mcp installs no custom CA and honors only the standard Node/undici proxy defaults.                                                                                                                              |
| HTTP 429, no Graph error envelope                                                 | `rate_limit` |    yes    | `facebook_usage` | HTTP 429 with no Graph error envelope (non-JSON body). Facebook sends its own throttles as HTTP 400 with a body code, so this one came from an edge, a CDN or an intercepting proxy: back off and retry idempotent reads, and run facebook_usage to check whether Graph itself is throttling you as well. If you are behind a corporate proxy or TLS interception, check HTTPS_PROXY, HTTP_PROXY, ALL_PROXY and NO_PROXY (and their lowercase forms): facebook-mcp installs no custom CA and honors only the standard Node/undici proxy defaults. |
| Any other HTTP 4xx, no Graph error envelope                                       |  `unknown`   |    no     |        —         | HTTP 4xx returned no Graph error envelope (non-JSON body). Inspect the status and the surfaced body snippet; do not retry automatically. If you are behind a corporate proxy or TLS interception, check HTTPS_PROXY, HTTP_PROXY, ALL_PROXY and NO_PROXY (and their lowercase forms): facebook-mcp installs no custom CA and honors only the standard Node/undici proxy defaults.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Network fault before the request was sent (DNS, connect), read or write           | `transient`  |    yes    |        —         | Network fault (connection failed) — the request provably never reached Facebook. Safe to retry idempotent reads after a short backoff; the api layer caps any internal wait at 60s and applies jitter. If you are behind a corporate proxy or TLS interception, check HTTPS_PROXY, HTTP_PROXY, ALL_PROXY and NO_PROXY (and their lowercase forms): facebook-mcp installs no custom CA and honors only the standard Node/undici proxy defaults.                                                                                                    |
| Network fault after the request was sent, on a read                               | `transient`  |    yes    |        —         | Network fault (connection reset before a response) — no Graph response was received. Safe to retry idempotent reads after a short backoff; the api layer caps any internal wait at 60s and applies jitter. If you are behind a corporate proxy or TLS interception, check HTTPS_PROXY, HTTP_PROXY, ALL_PROXY and NO_PROXY (and their lowercase forms): facebook-mcp installs no custom CA and honors only the standard Node/undici proxy defaults.                                                                                                |
| Network fault after the request was sent, HTTP 5xx, or code `1` / `2`, on a write | `ambiguous`  |    no     |        —         | Write outcome unknown — the request reached Facebook but the response was lost, so it may already have succeeded. Do NOT retry blindly; re-read the object you wrote (or the listing it belongs to) first, then decide.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
